daily.today_energy: Your emotional radar is extra sharp today, Cancer. Trust those gut feelings—they're basically your superpower right now. It's a great day to lean into your intuition and let it guide your decisions.
daily.love: Someone's been thinking about you more than you realize. Whether it's deepening an existing connection or a new spark on the horizon, the energy around you is magnetic. Show up authentically and see what happens.
daily.career: Your creativity is flowing hard today. This is the moment to pitch that idea you've been sitting on or approach a project from a fresh angle. Your unique perspective is exactly what's needed.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentleness today. Consider what actually nourishes you—whether that's rest, movement, or just being in your feels. Listen to what you need rather than pushing through.

weekly.overview: This week's energy is asking you to lean into your intuition, Cancer. The cosmos is rewarding your emotional depth with clarity—trust those gut feelings that have been whispering to you lately. It's time to act on what you already know.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or single, authenticity is your superpower right now. Stop playing it safe in conversations. Someone (or yourself) needs to hear what you're really thinking. Vulnerability isn't weakness—it's magnetic energy.
weekly.career: Your creative ideas are hitting different this week. Don't dim them down to fit the room. The momentum is real, and your ability to connect dots others miss is about to get recognized. Keep showing up as yourself.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for rest, not punishment. Check in with what actually nourishes you—whether that's movement, stillness, or just space to breathe. Energy flows where intention goes; set yours toward what feels genuinely good.
